name: Yakovlev Yak-52
summary: Soviet-designed, Romanian-built radial-engined aerobatic trainer, widely imported to the US as an affordable warbird.

wings: Low, straight wing with squared tips
engines: Nine-cylinder radial in a cowl with a front shutter
fuselage: Tandem two-seat cockpit with separate sliding canopy sections
Tricycle gear whose wheels stay partly exposed when retracted
tail: Single fin with low horizontal tail

tellTales: Radial-engined tandem trainer on tricycle gear with wheels that stay partly exposed when retracted
Cowl with a louvered shutter across the front

confusedWith.howToTell: The CJ-6 has a flat wing center section with sharply upturned outer panels; the Yak-52's wing has more uniform dihedral and the aircraft is smaller.
The T-34 has a slim flat-engine nose and fully retracting gear; the Yak-52 has a round radial nose and partly exposed wheels.
The T-28 is much larger and heavier with a deep cowl; the Yak-52 is small and compact.
The Yak-18T seats four under a long bubble canopy; the Yak-52 is a two-seat tandem trainer with a smaller canopy.
The Yak-50 is a single-seater with a tailwheel and retractable main gear; the Yak-52 has two seats in tandem and a retractable tricycle undercarriage.
The Yak-55 is a single-seat mid-wing aerobatic monoplane with fixed gear and a tailwheel; the Yak-52 has two seats and retractable tricycle gear.
